impact: MU and DRAM go into Nvidia earnings after a big run, so the bar is high; a strong Nvidia data-center guide supports HBM demand, a miss could unwind last week's gain.
summary: A FinanceFeeds week-ahead note puts Micron at $778 after a 12.8% gain last week, with a bull case of $885 and a bear case of $690 around Nvidia's results on Nov 17.
title: Micron at $778 after 12.8% weekly gain heading into Nvidia week
